name: completeness
purpose: Judge whether a change does everything the user asked (critic_score, once per call).

fields.name: task
fields.meaning: The user's request that the change implements, in their words or a faithful summary.

fields.name: change_summary
fields.meaning: What the change contains: its added code when short, otherwise file names, new definitions and their doc comments.

ask.yes: every requirement in `task` has matching work in `change_summary`
ask.no: at least one requirement in `task` has no matching work in `change_summary`

gate.reason: Kev: the change does not do everything the task asks
gate.calibration: 2026-09-27, scripts/calibrate-specs.mjs on 8 hand-written TypeScript/JavaScript tasks: 8 good vs 8 bad (each task with a full and a partial implementation); AUC 0.969; at 5% false rejects 75% caught
